clauses.reason: The sole command delegates only the President’s specified statutory authority vested until June30,1968. Authority to make new call-up orders ceases then. The maximum24-month active-duty period describes consequences of valid orders, not a continuing delegation or duty in this instrument. EO11366 addresses individual Ready Reserve members under different statutory authority and does not extend this unit-call-up delegation. Clause scope: delegation. Endpoint: 1968-06-30. For an express until date, record the stated day inclusive under the October21 owner ruling; the alternative exclusive reading ends at the beginning of that day and is disclosed.
